start_docstring_generation: start the docstring generation process for a repository using a config file and web integration
stop_docstring_generation: stop the running docstring generation process gracefully with a 5 second timeout before force killing
create_output_handler_thread: create an OutputHandler thread to read subprocess stdout and emit SocketIO events for status and log updates
parse_agent_status_output: parse STATUS lines from subprocess output to extract agent name and message for visualization updates
filter_visualization_output: filter out box drawing characters and progress indicators from subprocess log output using regex patterns
